<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:6">Cant. R. to II, 6</cite> (ref. to <he>ביתך …</he>, <cite ref="Deuteronomy 6:10">Deut. VI, 10</cite>) (on the door post to the right) of thy coming from the street to thy house.

<cite ref="Yoma 86b:18">Yoma 86ᵇ</cite> <he>ולואי … כב׳</he> oh, that the going out (of office) be (as pure) as the coming into! <cite ref="Yoma 86b:18">Ib.</cite> sq. <he>ב׳ כיציאה …</he> oh, that the coming home (from court) be (as sinless) as the going out (for holding court)! <cite ref="Bava Metzia 107a">B. Mets. 107ᵃ</cite> <he>ב׳ לעולם</he> birth. Y. Naz. VII, 56ᵈ top, a. fr. <he>בִּיאַת המקדש</he> entering the Temple.
Yoma 53ᵇ ב׳ ריקנית entering (the Holy of Holies) without incense, i.e. needlessly.—ביאת שמש sunset.

<cite ref="Berakhot 2a">Ber. 2ᵃ</cite> <he>ב׳ שמשו וכ׳</he> the sunset of his last day of levitical uncleanness prevents him from &c., i.e. is indispensable for his permission to eat T’rumah, v. <cite ref="I00102"><he>טְהֵר</he></cite>: a. fr.—Pl. <he>בִּיאוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 37b:5">Kidd. 37ᵇ</cite> <he>נאמרו ב׳ וכ׳</he> bibl. passages mentionning entrance into the promised land; a. fr.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kiddushin 1:1">Kidd. I, 1</cite>; a. fr.—<he>ביאת ערוה</he> incestuous connection.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 2:1:3">Y. Yeb. II, 3ᶜ</cite> bot.; a. fr.—<he>ב׳ מצוה</he>, v. <cite ref="M02284"><he>מִצְוָה</he></cite>.—Pl. as supra.
